BURHAN:v3p194/r5.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v3p194/r5.speaker: author
BURHAN:v3p194/r5.claim: A long interval is omitted before the command to John; the estimate is that he was born, grew up, and then received the instruction.
BURHAN:v3p194/r5.anchor: وقوله ﴿ يا يحيى خذ الكتاب بقوة وآتيناه الحكم صبيا ﴾ 2 حذف يطول تقديره فلما ولد يحيى ونشأ وترعرع

ITQAN:v1p243/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v1p243/r7.speaker: صفوان بن عسال
ITQAN:v1p243/r7.claim: Ṣafwān ibn ʿAssāl reports that when the Prophet recited Ya Yaḥyā with imāla and was told this was not Quraysh speech, he said it was the language of his maternal uncles, Banū Saʿd.
ITQAN:v1p243/r7.anchor: عن صفوان بن عسال أنه سمع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقرأ ﴿ يا يحيى ﴾ فقيل له

BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r1.claim: يا يحيى is introduced as an ellipsis of God's speech: He granted John and said, O John.
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r1.anchor: ووهبنا له يحيى وقلنا له يا يحيى

BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r2.speaker: الكاشفي
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r2.claim: Kashifi says the sign lasted three days, then Zakariyya recovered; after gestation John was born and practiced ascetic worship while young, before revelation came to him.
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r2.anchor: بعد از مضى مدت حمل متولد شد

BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r3.claim: The Book is the Torah; taking it with strength means earnestness, resolve, and support through divine enabling.
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r3.anchor: {خذ الكتاب} أي : التوراة {بقوة} بجد واستظهار بالتوفيق والتأييد

BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r4.speaker: الجلالين
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r4.claim: Jalalayn glosses the command as God giving John the Torah and strengthening him to memorize and act on it.
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r4.anchor: وقويتك على حفظها والعمل بما فيها

BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r5.speaker: المولى الجامي
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r5.claim: Jami says an unseen divine power enabled Zakariyya and his wife to conceive despite ordinary causes; that power passed from them to John.
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r5.anchor: لولا إمداد الحق زكريا وزوجته بقوة غيبية ربانية خارجة عن الأسباب المعتادة

BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r6.speaker: الأسئلة المقحمة
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r6.claim: A theological question asks how this proves the Mu'tazilite position; the answer says 'his name is John' and then addressing him by that name shows name and named person are one.
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r6.anchor: ثم نادى الشخص فقال : يا يحيى

BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r7.claim: Ibn Abbas says الحكم means prophethood, granted when John was three or seven; another view takes it as wisdom, Torah comprehension, and religious understanding.
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r7.anchor: قال ابن عباس : الحكم النبوة استنبأه الله تعالى وهو ابن ثلاث سنين أو سبع

BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r8.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
BURSEVI:v5p244#2/r8.claim: When other children invited him to play, John replied that they were not created for play; Kashifi uses the episode to warn against wasting precious life in heedlessness.

BURSEVI:v5p246/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p246/r3.speaker: التأويلات النجمية
BURSEVI:v5p246/r3.claim: The living heart receives the book of divine effusion by God's power rather than weak human power and becomes knowing, wise, merciful, pure of attachment to other-than-God, and pious.
BURSEVI:v5p246/r3.anchor: يا يحيى خذ كتاب الفيض الإلهي بقوة ربانية لا بقوة إنسانية لأنه خلق الإنسان ضعيفا

ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r1.claim: The omitted scene says that after John was born and reached the age for instruction, God called him, hastening to announce fulfillment of the promise.
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r1.anchor: على تقدير القول وكلام ءاخر حذف مسارعة إلى الأنباء بإنجاز الوعد الكريم

ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r2.speaker: ابن عطية
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r2.claim: Ibn ʿAtiyya claims consensus that the Book is the Torah, taking the definite article as referring to the only existing scripture; al-Alusi rejects consensus.
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r2.anchor: وادعى ابن عطية الإجماع على ذلك بناء على أن ال للعهد ولا معهود إذ ذاك سواها

ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r3.claim: Other interpretations make the Book a special scripture for John, Abraham's scrolls, or scripture in general.
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r3.anchor: بل قيل : له عليه السلام كتاب خص به كما خص كثير من الأنبياء عليهم السلام بمثل ذلك

ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r4.claim: Take the Book with strength means serious resolve, reliance, and acting on its teachings; God speaks through an angel, as commonly happens in prophetic address.
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r4.anchor: بجد واستظهار وعمل بما فيه وقائل ذلك هو الله تعالى على لسان الملك

ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r5.speaker: التبريزي
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r5.claim: Al-Tabrizi implausibly says John's father addressed him after he grew up; the following statement that God gave him judgment as a child makes this unlikely.
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r5.anchor: وأبعد التبريزي فقدر قال له أبوه حين ترعرع ونشأ

ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r6.claim: A report from Ibn Abbas, raised to the Prophet, says John received understanding and worship at age seven.
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r6.anchor: أخرج أبو نعيم وابن مردويه والديلمي عن ابن عباس عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال في ذلك : أعطي الفهم والعبادة

ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r7.claim: Another Prophetic report says boys invited John to play, but he answered that they were not created for play and urged prayer.
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r7.anchor: وجاء في رواية أخرى عنه مرفوعا أيضا قال الغلمان ليحيى بن زكريا عليهما السلام : اذهب بنا نلعب فقال

ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r8.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r8.claim: Judgment is variously glossed as wisdom, reason, manners of service, true insight, or prophethood; many place John's prophethood at age seven, three, or two.
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r8.anchor: وقيل : هي بمعنى العقل وقيل معرفة ءاداب الخدمة وقيل الفراسة الصادقة وقيل النبوة وعليه كثير

ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r9.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v16p72/r9.claim: The sentence about judgment coordinates with the omitted verb qulnā introducing God's call to John.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p221/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p221/r6.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p221/r6.claim: The address to Yaḥyā has an omitted clause: God bestowed Yaḥyā and said to him to take the Book.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p221/r6.anchor: {يا يحيى} قيل: فيه حذف معناه: ووهبنا له يحيى وقلنا له: يا يحيى،

BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p221/r7.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p221/r7.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p221/r7.claim: The Book is the Torah, and taking it with strength means diligently.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p221/r8.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p221/r8.speaker: ابن عباس
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p221/r8.claim: The wisdom given to Yaḥyā as a boy is prophethood; he was three years old.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p221/r8.anchor: قال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما: النبوة {صبيا} وهو ابن ثلاث سنين.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p221/r9.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p221/r9.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p221/r9.claim: Another view says the wisdom was understanding the Book, which he read as a child.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p221/r9.anchor: وقيل: أراد بالحكم فهم الكتاب (3) فقرأ التوراة وهو صغير.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p221/r10.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p221/r10.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p221/r10.claim: Some early authorities say anyone who reads the Qur'an before puberty is among those given wisdom as a child.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p221/r10.anchor: وعن بعض السلف: من قرأ القرآن قبل أن يبلغ فهو ممن أوتي الحكم صبيا (4)

BAYDAWI-FULL:19:10-12/r5.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:19:10-12/r5.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:19:10-12/r5.claim: Yahya is told to take the Torah earnestly and with God's enabling support; “judgment” given in childhood means wisdom and understanding of the Torah, or prophethood, with God maturing his mind while young.
BAYDAWI-FULL:19:10-12/r5.anchor: وقيل النبوة أحكم الله عقله في صباه

BIQAI-FULL:v4p523/r11.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v4p523/r11.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v4p523/r11.claim: Yahya is told to take up the Torah firmly and is granted judgment, understood as Torah knowledge, in childhood.
BIQAI-FULL:v4p523/r11.anchor: { الحكم } أي البنوة والفهم للتوراة { صبيا * }

BIQAI-FULL:v4p523/r12.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v4p523/r12.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v4p523/r12.claim: Receiving prophethood before maturity is extraordinary because that charge normally requires fully developed reason and strength.
BIQAI-FULL:v4p523/r12.anchor: لما كانت النبوة لا يستضلع بأمرها ويقوى على حملها إلا عند استحكام العقل ببلوغ الأشد

BIQAI-FULL:v4p523/r13.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v4p523/r13.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v4p523/r13.claim: Muhammad's people were not given this sign because they lacked a prior prophetic community whose denial would contradict their own history; his established truthfulness and enduring Qur'anic miracle served that role.
BIQAI-FULL:v4p523/r13.anchor: فعوض أعظم من ذلك بغرائز الصدق التي أوجبت له تسميته بالأمين

DURR-FULL:v5p484/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r5.speaker: مجاهد
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r5.claim: Mujahid says take the Scripture earnestly and glosses judgment as understanding.
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r5.anchor: عن مجاهد في قوله: {يا يحيى خذ الكتاب بقوة} قال: بجد {وآتيناه الحكم صبيا} قال: الفهم

DURR-FULL:v5p484/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r6.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r6.claim: Sa'id ibn Jubayr explains taking Scripture firmly as acting on its obligations.
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r6.anchor: عن سعيد بن جبير في قوله: {خذ الكتاب بقوة} يقول: اعمل بما فيه من فرائضه

DURR-FULL:v5p484/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r7.speaker: عكرمة
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r7.claim: Ikrima glosses judgment given in childhood as intellect.
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r7.anchor: عن مالك بن دينار قال: سألنا عكرمة عن قوله: {وآتيناه الحكم صبيا} قال: اللب

DURR-FULL:v5p484/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r8.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r8.claim: A report says Yahya received understanding and worship at age seven.
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r8.anchor: عن ابن عباس عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في قوله: {وآتيناه الحكم صبيا} قال: أعطي الفهم والعبادة

DURR-FULL:v5p484/r9.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r9.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r9.claim: Qatada says Yahya was three when given judgment.
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r9.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله: {وآتيناه الحكم صبيا} قال: وهو ابن ثلاث سنين

DURR-FULL:v5p484/r10.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r10.speaker: معمر بن راشد
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r10.claim: A report reaching Ma'mar says Yahya refused boys' invitation to play, saying he was not created for play.
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r10.anchor: عن معمر بن راشد في قوله: {وآتيناه الحكم صبيا} قال: بلغني أن الصبيان قالوا

DURR-FULL:v5p484/r11.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r11.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r11.claim: Qatada recounts that Yahya told boys he was not created for play; this was the occasion for the description.
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r11.anchor: عن قتادة قال: جاء الغلمان إلى يحيى بن زكريا فقال: ما للعب خلقت

DURR-FULL:v5p484/r12.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r12.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r12.claim: A report attributed to the Prophet through Muadh repeats Yahya's refusal to play.
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r12.anchor: وأخرجه ابن عساكر عن معاذ بن جبل مرفوعا

DURR-FULL:v5p484/r13.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r13.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r13.claim: In another report, Yahya says he was not created for play and sends the boys to pray.
DURR-FULL:v5p484/r13.anchor: عن ابن عباس قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم - قال الغلمان ليحيى بن زكريا

DURR-FULL:v5p485/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p485/r1.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR-FULL:v5p485/r1.claim: A Prophetic report says whoever recites Qur'an before puberty received judgment in childhood; another transmission stops at Ibn Abbas.
DURR-FULL:v5p485/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: من قرأ القرآن قبل أن يحتلم فقد أوتي الحكم صبيا

QUSHAYRI:v2p237/r1.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v2p237/r1.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v2p237/r1.claim: The command to take the Book with strength means strength of heart, not physical force; God specially granted it as prophecy.
QUSHAYRI:v2p237/r1.anchor: لا قوة يد ولكن قوة قلب ، وذلك خير خصه الله تعالى به

QUSHAYRI:v2p237/r2.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v2p237/r2.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v2p237/r2.claim: The verse indicates that Yahya had a revealed book.
QUSHAYRI:v2p237/r2.anchor: ودلت الآية على أنه كان من الله له كتاب

QUSHAYRI:v2p237/r3.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v2p237/r3.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v2p237/r3.claim: Wisdom may mean prophecy bestowed on Yahya while still a child.
QUSHAYRI:v2p237/r3.anchor: أي النبوة ، بعثه الله بها إلى قومه

QUSHAYRI:v2p237/r4.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v2p237/r4.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v2p237/r4.claim: Alternatively, wisdom means judging people by what is right and true.
QUSHAYRI:v2p237/r4.anchor: ويقال الحكم بالصواب والحق بين الناس

QUSHAYRI:v2p237/r5.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v2p237/r5.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v2p237/r5.claim: A further reading defines wisdom as carrying out an act in accordance with its command.
QUSHAYRI:v2p237/r5.anchor: ويقال الحكم هو إحكام الفعل على وجه الأمر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p75/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p75/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p75/r1.claim: The words to Yahya are an omitted divine speech, marking the transition from his announcement to his prophethood; they are Quranic narration, not necessarily words spoken to Zachariah.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p75/r1.anchor: والأظهر أن هذا من إخبار القرآن للأمة لا من حكاية ما قيل لزكرياء

IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p75/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p75/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p75/r2.claim: The Book is the Torah; taking it means understanding and applying it, and taking it with قوة means firm resolve to follow it and lead the community in following it as Jewish practice was weakening.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p75/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p75/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p75/r3.claim: الحكم can mean prophethood, as in other Quranic usage, or wisdom and understanding; Ibn Ashur finds childhood prophethood unlikely and reads صبيا as exceptional sound judgment and perception in boyhood.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p75/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p75/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p75/r4.claim: Yahya did receive prophethood well before forty; perhaps God hastened it because he intended Yahya to be martyred early in life.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p75/r4.anchor: واتفق العلماء على أن يحيى أعطي النبوءة قبل بلوغ الأربعين سنة بكثير

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r1.claim: The book is the Torah, since Yahya preceded Jesus and the Gospel.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r1.anchor: والكتاب التوراة بلا اختلاف لأنه ولد قبل عيسى

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r2.claim: Grasping the book firmly means learning, memorizing, acting on it, and keeping its obligations.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r2.anchor: العلم به والحفظ له والعمل به والالتزام للوازمه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r3.speaker: فرقة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r3.claim: One group says judgment means legal rulings and knowledge of them, and “as a child” means a young man not yet middle-aged.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r4.speaker: الحسن
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r4.claim: Al-Hasan interprets judgment as prophethood, with “child” used figuratively or as an enduring description.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r5.speaker: فرقة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r5.claim: Another group says judgment means wisdom; Maʿmar transmits that Yahya refused children’s invitation to play because he was not created for play.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r5.anchor: وقالت فرقة الحكم الحكمة، وروى معمر

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r6.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas says anyone who recites the Qurʾan before puberty is granted judgment as a child.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p7#2/r6.anchor: وقال ابن عباس: من قرأ القرآن من قبل أن يحتلم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#2/r1.claim: Zakariya emerged from the prayer niche on the morning after his wife conceived; the account is discussed at 3:39.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#2/r1.anchor: في صبيحة الليلة التي حملت فيها امرأته من المحراب أي من مصلاه

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#2/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#2/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#2/r2.claim: One explanation of awḥā is that Zakariya wrote them a message.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#2/r2.anchor: أنه كتب اليهم في كتاب قاله ابن عباس

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#2/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#2/r3.speaker: مجاهد
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#2/r3.claim: The other explanation is that he gestured with his head and hands.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#2/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#2/r4.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#2/r4.claim: Tasbīḥ here means praying morning and evening; Zakariya had directed the people to pray then and signaled this instruction when his wife conceived.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#2/r4.anchor: أن سبحوا أي صلوا بكرة وعشيا قد شرحناه في آل عمران 39

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r1.speaker: الزجاج
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r1.claim: The verse means God gave Yaḥya to Zakariya and told the child to take the Torah and hold to it.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r1.anchor: المعنى فوهبنا له يحيى وقلنا له يا يحيى خذ الكتاب يعني التوراة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r2.speaker: ابن الأنباري
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r2.claim: Another explanation is to accept all God's books in faith and put their rulings into practice.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r2.anchor: اقبل كتب الله كلها ايمانا بها واستعمالا لأحكامها

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r3.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r3.claim: He refers readers to the discussion of bi-quwwa at 2:63.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r3.anchor: وقد شرحنا في البقرة 63 معنى قوله بقوة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r4.speaker: مجاهد
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r4.claim: One interpretation of al-ḥukm is understanding.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r7.speaker: أبو سليمان الدمشقي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r7.claim: He interprets it as memorizing and knowing the Torah; the fuller discussion is in 12:23.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r7.anchor: حفظ التوراة وعلمها قاله أبو سليمان الدمشقي وقد زدنا هذا شرحا

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r8.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r8.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r8.claim: He says a person who recites the Quran before puberty is among those granted wisdom as a child.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r8.anchor: من قرأ القرآن من قبل أن يحتلم فهو ممن أوتي الحكم صبيا

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r9.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r9.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r9.claim: One report says Yaḥya received wisdom at age seven; another view, from Qatada and Muqatil, says age three.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p212#3/r9.anchor: أحدهما أنه سبع سنين رواه ابن عباس عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

SULAMI:v1p422#4/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p422#4/r1.speaker: الواسطي
SULAMI:v1p422#4/r1.claim: Yahya should take the Book through strength of heart and confidence in his Lord, not through prostration, tears, or pleading; this shows God may honor or abase whomever He wills without a cause.
SULAMI:v1p422#4/r1.anchor: قال الواسطي رحمه الله : خذه بقوة قلبك وثقة بربك لا بسجود وبكاء وتضرع

SULAMI:v1p422#4/r2.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p422#4/r2.speaker: ابن عطاء
SULAMI:v1p422#4/r2.claim: The judgment given to Yahya means gnosis.

SULAMI:v1p422#4/r3.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p422#4/r3.speaker: جعفر
SULAMI:v1p422#4/r3.claim: The judgment means divinely granted success in practicing the proper manners of service.
SULAMI:v1p422#4/r3.anchor: قال جعفر : التوفيق لاستعمال آداب الخدمة

SULAMI:v1p422#4/r4.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p422#4/r4.speaker: الحسين
SULAMI:v1p422#4/r4.claim: Yahya's spirit was formed from the lights of witnessing, and his self from the manners of servitude and spiritual struggle, explaining the wisdom given in childhood.
SULAMI:v1p422#4/r4.anchor: قال الحسين : كان روح يحيى معجونا بأنوار المشاهدة ونفسه معجونة بآداب العبودية

SULAMI:v1p422#4/r5.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p422#4/r5.speaker: بعضهم
SULAMI:v1p422#4/r5.claim: Judgment means hitting upon what is true in speech, action, and states.
SULAMI:v1p422#4/r5.anchor: قال بعضهم : الحكم إصابة الحق في الأقوال والأفعال والأحوال

SULAMI:v1p422#4/r6.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p422#4/r6.speaker: يوسف بن الحسين
SULAMI:v1p422#4/r6.claim: Yahya was given discernment into the unseen and truthful intuition untouched by doubt.
SULAMI:v1p422#4/r6.anchor: قال يوسف بن الحسين : في قوله : ﴿ وآتيناه الحكم صبيا ﴾ أوتي يحيى عليه السلام حكما على الغيب

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p216/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p216/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p216/r1.claim: The account implies Yahya had been born and God taught him the Torah, studied and judged by Israel's prophets and religious scholars.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p216/r1.anchor: وأن الله علمه الكتاب، وهو التوراة التي كانوا يتدارسونها بينهم، ويحكم بها النبيون

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p216/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p216/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p216/r2.claim: Taking the book with strength means learning it earnestly, eagerly, and with effort.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p216/r2.anchor: أي: تعلم الكتاب {بقوة} أي: بجد وحرص واجتهاد

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p216/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p216/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p216/r3.claim: Wisdom as a child means understanding, knowledge, seriousness, resolve, devotion to good, and diligent effort while young.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p216/r3.anchor: أي: الفهم والعلم والجد والعزم، والإقبال على الخير، والإكباب عليه، والاجتهاد فيه

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p216/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p216/r4.speaker: عبد الله بن المبارك
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p216/r4.claim: Ibn al-Mubarak transmits from Maʿmar that when children invited Yahya to play, he said he was not created for play.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p216/r4.anchor: قال عبد الله بن المبارك: قال معمر: قال الصبيان ليحيى بن زكريا: اذهب بنا نلعب.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p218/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p218/r2.speaker: الحسن
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p218/r2.claim: Hasan reports that Jesus and Yahya each asked the other to seek forgiveness, each calling the other better; Jesus cites Yahya's divine peace as evidence of merit.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p218/r2.anchor: عن قتادة: أن حسن قال: إن يحيى وعيسى، عليهما السلام، التقيا، فقال له عيسى: استغفر لي، أنت خير مني،

JISHUMI:v6p4528/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v6p4528/r6.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v6p4528/r6.claim: The call to Yahya omits its context: God said it after Yahya was created and came to understanding; views differ on whether he had reached maturity or had sound reason as a child.
JISHUMI:v6p4528/r6.anchor: وفيه حذف، أي: قلنا ليحيى لما خلق وعقل، واختلفوا، قيل: قال هذا لما بلغ أشده

JISHUMI:v6p4528/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v6p4528/r7.speaker: أبو علي
JISHUMI:v6p4528/r7.claim: Abu Ali calls the narration of Yahya's childhood command an extraordinary compression unlike human speech.
JISHUMI:v6p4528/r7.anchor: قال أبو علي: وهذا من عجيب الاختصار الذي لا يوجد في كلام الناس

JISHUMI:v6p4528/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v6p4528/r8.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v6p4528/r8.claim: The Book is the Torah; taking it with strength means diligent practice, sincere resolve, or using the capacity God gave him.
JISHUMI:v6p4528/r8.anchor: خذ الكتاب قيل: التوراة بقوة قيل: بجد واجتهاد ومواظبة في العمل به

JISHUMI:v6p4528/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v6p4528/r9.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v6p4528/r9.claim: Ḥukm in childhood may mean wisdom and knowledge or prophethood.
JISHUMI:v6p4528/r9.anchor: وآتيناه الحكم صبيا قيل: الحكمة والعلم في حال صباه، وقيل: النبوة

JISHUMI:v6p4528/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v6p4528/r10.speaker: معمر
JISHUMI:v6p4528/r10.claim: When other children invited Yahya to play, he replied that they were not created for play; this is linked to his being given judgment as a child.
JISHUMI:v6p4528/r10.anchor: وعن معمر أن الصبيان قالوا ليحيى: اذهب نلعب، قال: ما للعب خلقنا

JISHUMI:v6p4530/r12.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v6p4530/r12.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v6p4530/r12.claim: Capacity precedes action, as the command to take the Book with strength shows, contradicting the determinists.
JISHUMI:v6p4530/r12.anchor: وتدل على أن القدرة قبل الفعل؛ لذلك قال: بقوة؛ فيبطل قول المجبرة في الاستطاعة

JISHUMI:v6p4530/r13.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v6p4530/r13.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v6p4530/r13.claim: Take means an act performed by Yahya; the command and need for strength refute the view that God creates human actions.
JISHUMI:v6p4530/r13.anchor: ويدل قوله: خذ أن الأخذ فعله، فيبطل قولهم في المخلوق، ولأنه لو كان خلقه لما كان صح الأمر به

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r1.claim: Yahya is told to take the Torah seriously and preserve it with divine enabling and support.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r1.anchor: أي خذ التوراة بجد واستظهار بالتوفيق والتأييد

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r2.claim: Al-ḥukm means wisdom; a cited poetic phrase using aḥkamu supplies linguistic evidence.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r2.anchor: { الحكم } الحكمة . ومنه : وآحكم كحكم فتاة الحي

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r3.claim: Ibn Abbas explains wisdom here as understanding the Torah and religious jurisprudence.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r3.anchor: وهو الفهم للتوراة والفقه في الدين عن ابن عباس

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r4.speaker: الضحاك
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r4.claim: Al-Dahhak says that when children invited Yahya to play, he answered that they were not created for play.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r4.anchor: وقيل : دعاء الصبيان إلى اللعب وهو صبي فقال : ما للعب خلقنا

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r5.speaker: معمر
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r5.anchor: ما للعب خلقنا ، عن الضحاك . وعن معمر : العقل

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r6.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r6.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r6.claim: Another interpretation is prophethood: God made Yahya's intellect firm in childhood and revealed to him.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p9#3/r6.anchor: وقيل النبوة ، لأن الله أحكم عقله في صباه وأوحى إليه

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r1.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r1.claim: The command to take the Book firmly may be Zakariya's words to Yaḥyā as he grew up.
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r1.anchor: أحدهما : أنه قول زكريا ليحيى حين نشأ .

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r2.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r2.claim: Alternatively, it is God's command to Yaḥyā when he reached maturity.
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r2.anchor: الثاني : قول الله ليحيى حين بلغ .

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r3.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r3.claim: The Book may be the scriptures of Abraham.

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r4.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r4.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r4.claim: Alternatively, the Book is the Torah.

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r5.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r5.speaker: مجاهد
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r5.claim: Taking the Book firmly means taking it with earnestness and effort.

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r6.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r6.speaker: زيد بن أسلم
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r6.claim: Taking it firmly means obeying its commands and abstaining from its prohibitions.
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r6.anchor: الثاني : العمل بما فيه من أمر والكف عما فيه من نهي , قاله زيد بن أسلم .

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r7.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r7.speaker: الحسن
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r7.claim: Ḥukm given to Yaḥyā as a child can mean intelligence.

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r9.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r9.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r9.claim: Ḥukm can mean knowledge of rulings and the rulings themselves.
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r9.anchor: الثالث : الأحكام والمعرفة بها . الرابع : الحكمة .

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r10.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r10.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r10.anchor: الثالث : الأحكام والمعرفة بها . الرابع : الحكمة . قال معمر

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r11.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r11.speaker: معمر ومقاتل
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r11.claim: A report says children invited Yaḥyā to play, but he replied that he was not created for play; Muqatil says he was three years old.
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p359#2/r11.anchor: قال معمر : إن الصبيان قالوا ليحيى إذهب بنا نلعب فقال ما للعب خلقت

MUJAHID:v1p384#5/r1.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v1p384#5/r1.speaker: مجاهد
MUJAHID:v1p384#5/r1.claim: Mujahid explains taking the Book with strength as earnestness in obeying God.
MUJAHID:v1p384#5/r1.anchor: عن مجاهد ﴿ يا يحيى خذ الكتاب بقوة ﴾ يعني بجد في طاعة الله عز وجل

MUJAHID:v1p384#5/r2.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v1p384#5/r2.speaker: مجاهد
MUJAHID:v1p384#5/r2.claim: Mujahid glosses hananan from God as compassion from the Lord toward John.
MUJAHID:v1p384#5/r2.anchor: عن مجاهد ﴿ وحنانا من لدنا ﴾ قال يعني تعطفا من ربه عليه

MUQATIL:19:10-12/r4.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:19:10-12/r4.speaker: author
MUQATIL:19:10-12/r4.claim: The Book given to Yahya is the Torah, and taking it firmly means applying oneself to it diligently and consistently.
MUQATIL:19:10-12/r4.anchor: يعني التوراة، { بقوة } ، يعني بجد ومواظبة عليه

MUQATIL:19:10-12/r5.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:19:10-12/r5.speaker: author
MUQATIL:19:10-12/r5.claim: Yahya was given knowledge and understanding as a three-year-old child.
MUQATIL:19:10-12/r5.anchor: يعني وأعطينا يحيى العلم والفهم وهو ابن ثلاث سنين.

NASAFI-FULL:v3p32#4/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p32#4/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p32#4/r1.claim: The address يا يحيى means God gave him Yahya and spoke to him after his birth, when he could understand address.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p32#4/r1.anchor: أي وهبنا له يحيى وقلنا له بعد ولادته وأوان الخطاب يا يحيى

NASAFI-FULL:v3p32#4/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p32#4/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p32#4/r2.claim: The Book is the Torah, and taking it with قوة means seriousness, supported by divine enabling and aid.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p32#4/r2.anchor: التوراة ﴿ بقوة ﴾ حال أي بجد واستظهار بالتوفيق والتأييد

NASAFI-FULL:v3p32#4/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p32#4/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p32#4/r3.claim: The الحكم given in childhood is wisdom: understanding the Torah and religious jurisprudence.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p32#4/r3.anchor: الحكمة وهو فهم التوراة والفقه في الدين

NASAFI-FULL:v3p32#4/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p32#4/r4.speaker: قيل
NASAFI-FULL:v3p32#4/r4.claim: A report says children invited Yahya to play while he was still a child, and he replied that they were not created for play.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p32#4/r4.anchor: قيل دعاه الصبيان إلى اللعب وهو صبي فقال ما للعب خلقنا

QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r14.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r14.claim: The account omits the birth narrative: God addresses the newborn Yahya, an ellipsis whose meaning is supplied by context.
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r14.anchor: في الكلام حذف المعنى فولد له ولد وقال الله تعالى للمولود

QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r15.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r15.claim: The Book Yahya is told to grasp is the Torah, without disagreement.

QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r16.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r16.speaker: مجاهد
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r16.claim: Mujahid explains grasping the Book with strength as undertaking it earnestly and diligently.
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r16.anchor: بقوة» أي بجد واجتهاد قاله مجاهد

QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r17.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r17.speaker: زيد بن أسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r17.claim: Zayd ibn Aslam explains strength as learning, memorizing, and acting on the Book by obeying commands and avoiding prohibitions.
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r17.anchor: العلم به، والحفظ له والعمل به، وهو الالتزام لأوامره، والكف عن نواهيه قاله زيد بن أسلم

QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r18.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r18.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r18.claim: The phrase about being given judgment as a child can mean sound judgment and knowledge of its application.
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r18.anchor: قيل: الأحكام والمعرفة بها. وروى معمر أن الصبيان

QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r19.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r19.speaker: معمر
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r19.claim: Ma‘mar reports that when children invited Yahya to play, he replied that he was not created for play; this is connected to his receiving judgment as a child.
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r19.anchor: وروى معمر أن الصبيان قالوا ليحيى: اذهب بنا نلعب فقال: ما للعب خلقت

QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r20.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r20.speaker: قتادة
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r20.claim: Qatada says Yahya was two or three years old when given judgment.
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r20.anchor: وقال قتادة: كان ابن سنتين أو ثلاث سنين

QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r21.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r21.speaker: مقاتل
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r21.claim: Muqatil says Yahya was three years old.
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r21.anchor: وقال مقاتل: كان ابن ثلاث سنين

QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r22.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r22.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r22.claim: Subiyyan is an accusative circumstantial expression describing Yahya as a child.
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r22.anchor: صبيا» نصب على الحال. وقال ابن عباس: من قرأ

QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r23.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r23.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r23.claim: Ibn Abbas says anyone who recites the Qur’an before puberty is among those given judgment as a child.
QURTUBI-FULL:19:11-12/r23.anchor: من قرأ القرآن قبل أن يحتلم فهو ممن أوتي الحكم صبيا

RAZI-FULL:v21p163/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v21p163/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v21p163/r1.claim: God's address to Yaḥyā shows that he had reached an age at which he could be addressed; the omitted explanation is understood from context.
RAZI-FULL:v21p163/r1.anchor: يدل على أن الله تعالى بلغ بيحيى المبلغ الذي يجوز أن يخاطبه بذلك

RAZI-FULL:v21p163/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v21p163/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v21p163/r2.claim: The book is likely the Torah, the scripture already familiar from the account of Israel, rather than a separate book specially given to Yaḥyā.

RAZI-FULL:v21p163/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v21p163/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v21p163/r3.claim: Take the book with strength means diligence and patience in carrying out prophetic duties, not mere physical ability to pick it up.
RAZI-FULL:v21p163/r3.anchor: ليس المراد منه القدرة على الأخذ لأن ذلك معلوم لكل أحد

RAZI-FULL:v21p163/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v21p163/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v21p163/r4.claim: One interpretation of ḥukm is wisdom, understanding the Torah, and insight into religion, supported by a line about a discerning girl judging doves.
RAZI-FULL:v21p163/r4.anchor: الأول : أنه الحكمة ومنه قول الشاعر : واحكم كحكم فتاة الحي

RAZI-FULL:v21p163#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v21p163#2/r1.speaker: معمر
RAZI-FULL:v21p163#2/r1.claim: Maʿmar interprets ḥukm as reason and reports that Yaḥyā said, We were not created to play.
RAZI-FULL:v21p163#2/r1.anchor: وهو قول معمر أنه العقل روي أنه قال ما للعب خلقنا

RAZI-FULL:v21p163#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v21p163#2/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v21p163#2/r2.claim: Al-Rāzī prefers that ḥukm means prophethood: the passage lists honors, prophethood is the greatest honor, and the word can mean authority to judge others.

RAZI-FULL:v21p163#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v21p163#2/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v21p163#2/r3.claim: There is no special difficulty in a child having reason or prophethood unless one denies miracles; accepting extraordinary events removes the objection, since those are also departures from habit.
RAZI-FULL:v21p163#2/r3.anchor: فإنه ليس استبعاد صيرورة الصبي عاقلا أشد من استبعاد انشقاق القمر

STUDYQURAN:19:2/r44.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:19:2/r44.speaker: Q, Ṭ
STUDYQURAN:19:2/r44.claim: The address to John is understood to come immediately after his birth and commands earnest observance of the Torah.
STUDYQURAN:19:2/r44.anchor: understood to have been made immediately after his birth (Q, Ṭ); it enjoins him to take the Book—that is, the Torah—with strength

STUDYQURAN:19:2/r45.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:19:2/r45.speaker: Ṭ
STUDYQURAN:19:2/r45.claim: Taking the Torah with strength means seriously following it and observing its commands and prohibitions.
STUDYQURAN:19:2/r45.anchor: to follow it in earnest and to observe its commands and prohibitions (Ṭ).

STUDYQURAN:19:2/r46.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:19:2/r46.speaker: R
STUDYQURAN:19:2/r46.claim: Judgment may mean understanding of scripture given in youth or John’s prophethood.
STUDYQURAN:19:2/r46.anchor: refers to the understanding of the Book that God gave John as a youth or perhaps to his prophethood (R).

STUDYQURAN:19:2/r47.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:19:2/r47.speaker: Ṭ
STUDYQURAN:19:2/r47.claim: John’s precocious spiritual understanding reportedly made him uninterested in play as a child.
STUDYQURAN:19:2/r47.anchor: made him disinterested in play as a child (Ṭ).

NAHHAS:v3p7/r11.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v3p7/r11.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v3p7/r11.claim: خذ derives from أخذ; the second hamza drops through frequent use or adjoining gutturals, and ذ takes kasra where silent letters meet.
NAHHAS:v3p7/r11.anchor: من أخذ يأخذ الأصل أوخذ حذفت الهمزة الثانية لكثرة الاستعمال

NAHHAS:v3p7/r12.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v3p7/r12.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v3p7/r12.claim: صبيا is a circumstantial accusative marking John's age when given judgment.

TAB-FULL:v15p474/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v15p474/r1.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v15p474/r1.claim: He glosses taking the Book with strength as doing so diligently.
TAB-FULL:v15p474/r1.anchor: عن قتادة، في قوله: {خذ الكتاب بقوة} [مريم: 12] قال: بجد

TAB-FULL:v15p474/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v15p474/r2.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v15p474/r2.claim: He likewise glosses taking the Book with strength as earnest commitment.
TAB-FULL:v15p474/r2.anchor: عن مجاهد، {خذ الكتاب بقوة} [مريم: 12] قال: بجد

TAB-FULL:v15p474/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v15p474/r3.speaker: ابن زيد
TAB-FULL:v15p474/r3.claim: He says strength means doing God's commands and avoiding His prohibitions.
TAB-FULL:v15p474/r3.anchor: قال ابن زيد، في قوله: {يا يحيى خذ الكتاب بقوة} [مريم: 12] قال: القوة: أن يعمل ما أمره الله به

TAB-FULL:v15p474#2/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v15p474#2/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v15p474#2/r1.claim: God gave Yaḥyā understanding of the Book while still a child, before reaching adulthood.
TAB-FULL:v15p474#2/r1.anchor: قال: بلغني أن الصبيان قالوا ليحيى: اذهب بنا نلعب، فقال: ما للعب خلقت

TAB-FULL:v15p474#2/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v15p474#2/r2.speaker: معمر
TAB-FULL:v15p474#2/r2.claim: A report says children invited Yaḥyā to play; he said he was not created for play, and God gave him wisdom as a child.
TAB-FULL:v15p474#2/r2.anchor: قال: بلغني أن الصبيان قالوا ليحيى: اذهب بنا نلعب، فقال: ما للعب خلقت

TABATABAI:19:7-9/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:19:7-9/r4.speaker: author
TABATABAI:19:7-9/r4.claim: Yahya receives unique descriptions: wisdom as a child, leadership and chastity, and peace at birth, death, and resurrection; Jesus shared them but was born later, though they were cousins.
TABATABAI:19:7-9/r4.anchor: نعته في كلامه بنعوت لم ينعت به أحدا من أنبيائه وأوليائه قبله

TABATABAI:19:12/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:19:12/r3.speaker: author
TABATABAI:19:12/r3.claim: Taking the book with strength means committing seriously to its teachings in both knowledge and practice; the omitted transition is that after Yahya was granted, God commanded him to take it firmly.
TABATABAI:19:12/r3.anchor: أن المراد من أخذ الكتاب بقوة التحقق بما فيه من المعارف والعمل بما فيه من الأحكام

TABATABAI:19:12/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:19:12/r4.speaker: author
TABATABAI:19:12/r4.claim: The book is likely the Torah, or it and earlier prophetic books, since the Torah contained the law in force at that time.
TABATABAI:19:12/r4.anchor: فإن الكتاب الذي كان يشتمل على الشريعة يومئذ هو التوراة

TABATABAI:19:12-13/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:19:12-13/r1.speaker: بعضهم
TABATABAI:19:12-13/r1.claim: Interpreters gloss hukm as understanding, reason, wisdom, service etiquette, insight, or prophethood.
TABATABAI:19:12-13/r1.anchor: فسر الحكم بالفهم وبالعقل وبالحكمة وبمعرفة آداب الخدمة

TABATABAI:19:12-13/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:19:12-13/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:19:12-13/r2.claim: Hukm cannot mean prophethood because the Qur’an distinguishes judgment from prophethood, and the other proposed senses lack linguistic or contextual evidence.
TABATABAI:19:12-13/r2.anchor: أن الحكم غير النبوة، فتفسير الحكم بالنبوة ليس على ما ينبغي

TABATABAI:19:12-13/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:19:12-13/r3.speaker: author
TABATABAI:19:12-13/r3.claim: The parallel pairing of scripture, wisdom, and purification suggests hukm is knowledge of true divine realities, including what lies beyond ordinary perception; Yahya received it as a child before puberty.
TABATABAI:19:12-13/r3.anchor: أن المراد بالحكم العلم بالمعارف الحقة الإلهية وانكشاف ما هو تحت أستار الغيب

TABATABAI:19:14/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:19:14/r3.speaker: معمر
TABATABAI:19:14/r3.claim: Maʿmar reports that when children invited John to play, he replied that he was not created for play; al-Riḍa also transmits this account.
TABATABAI:19:14/r3.anchor: عن معمر قال إن الصبيان قالوا ليحيى اذهب بنا نلعب

TABATABAI:19:14/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:19:14/r4.speaker: علي بن أسباط
TABATABAI:19:14/r4.claim: Ali ibn Asbat says al-Baqir cited John's childhood wisdom and the verse about reaching full strength at forty to show that wisdom can be granted in childhood or adulthood.
TABATABAI:19:14/r4.anchor: إن الله احتج في الإمامة بمثل ما احتج به في النبوة

TABATABAI:19:14/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:19:14/r5.speaker: author
TABATABAI:19:14/r5.claim: Al-Baqir's report interprets hukm as wisdom and supports the author's preceding explanation.
TABATABAI:19:14/r5.anchor: وفي الرواية تفسير الحكم بالحكمة فتؤيد ما قدمناه

TABATABAI:19:1-15#6/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:19:1-15#6/r3.speaker: author
TABATABAI:19:1-15#6/r3.claim: The Qur'an praises John as affirming Jesus's prophethood, a leader, chaste, prophet, righteous, elect and guided; God named him uniquely, gave him wisdom as a child, and greeted him at the three stages.
TABATABAI:19:1-15#6/r3.anchor: كان مصدقا بكلمة من الله وهو تصديقه بنبوة المسيح

TABATABAI:19:1-15#6/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:19:1-15#6/r4.speaker: author
TABATABAI:19:1-15#6/r4.claim: John was born miraculously to an elderly father and barren mother, embraced worship and asceticism from childhood, never married, and lived alongside Jesus whom he affirmed.
TABATABAI:19:1-15#6/r4.anchor: فقد كان أبوه شيخا فانيا وأمه عاقرا

TABATABAI:19:1-15#6/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:19:1-15#6/r5.speaker: author
TABATABAI:19:1-15#6/r5.claim: John was loved by his people and gathered them to preach repentance and piety until he was martyred.
TABATABAI:19:1-15#6/r5.anchor: تحن إليه القلوب وتميل إليه النفوس ويجتمع إليه الناس فيعظهم

TABATABAI:19:1-15#6/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:19:1-15#6/r6.speaker: author
TABATABAI:19:1-15#6/r6.claim: One report says a woman beloved by the Israelite king sought John's head after he rebuked the king's conduct; the king ordered John beheaded and his head given to her.
TABATABAI:19:1-15#6/r6.anchor: امرأة بغيا افتتن بها ملك بني إسرائيل وكان يأتيها فنهاه يحيى

TABATABAI:19:1-15#6/r7.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:19:1-15#6/r7.speaker: author
TABATABAI:19:1-15#6/r7.claim: Another report says the king's niece asked for John's head after her mother prompted her when the king sought to marry her, because John had forbidden the marriage.
TABATABAI:19:1-15#6/r7.anchor: ابنة أخي الملك وكان يريد أن يتزوج بها فنهاه يحيى

TABRISI:19:12-13/r3.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:19:12-13/r3.speaker: author
TABRISI:19:12-13/r3.claim: The preposition bi in bi-quwwa marks a circumstantial state: Yahya is to take the Book earnestly and diligently.
TABRISI:19:12-13/r3.anchor: الباء في موضع الحال أي خذ الكتاب مجدا مجتهدا

TABRISI:19:12-13/r4.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:19:12-13/r4.speaker: author
TABRISI:19:12-13/r4.claim: The narrative compresses the grant of Yahya: God gave him understanding and reason, then commanded him to take the Torah with strength God supplied.
TABRISI:19:12-13/r4.anchor: ها هنا اختصار عجيب تقديره فوهبنا له يحيى وأعطيناه الفهم

TABRISI:19:12-13/r5.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:19:12-13/r5.speaker: author
TABRISI:19:12-13/r5.claim: Bi-quwwa can also mean with serious resolve and firm determination to follow the Book.
TABRISI:19:12-13/r5.anchor: وقيل: معناه بجد وصحة عزيمة على القيام بما فيه

TABRISI:19:12-13/r6.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:19:12-13/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
TABRISI:19:12-13/r6.claim: Hukm means prophethood granted to Yahya as a child of three years.
TABRISI:19:12-13/r6.anchor: أي آتيناه النبوة في حال صباه وهو ابن ثلاث سنين عن ابن عباس

TABRISI:19:12-13/r7.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:19:12-13/r7.speaker: علي بن أسباط عن أبي جعفر
TABRISI:19:12-13/r7.claim: Imam Baqir, then five, says God’s granting of imamate can occur in childhood just as prophecy was granted to Yahya as a child.
TABRISI:19:12-13/r7.anchor: إن الله قد أخذ في الإمامة كما أخذ في النبوة

TABRISI:19:12-13/r8.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:19:12-13/r8.speaker: مجاهد
TABRISI:19:12-13/r8.claim: Hukm may mean understanding the Book; Maʿmar reports that when boys invited Yahya to play, he answered that they were not created for play.
TABRISI:19:12-13/r8.anchor: قال إن الصبيان قالوا ليحيى اذهب بنا لنلعب

THALABI:v6p207#2/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v6p207#2/r1.speaker: author
THALABI:v6p207#2/r1.claim: Yahya is told to take the Scripture earnestly and was given understanding as a child.
THALABI:v6p207#2/r1.anchor: قوله يا يحيى خذ الكتاب بقوة بجد وآتيناه الحكم يعني الفهم صبيا

THALABI:v6p207#2/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v6p207#2/r2.speaker: معمر
THALABI:v6p207#2/r2.claim: Maʿmar recounts that when children invited Yahya to play, he answered that he was not created for play; this illustrates wisdom in childhood.
THALABI:v6p207#2/r2.anchor: وقال معمر: جاء صبيان إلى يحيى بن زكريا فقالوا: اخرج بنا نلعب، فقال: ما للعب خلقت،

WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r1.speaker: أبو إسحاق
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r1.claim: The wording is elliptical: God gave Yahya to Zechariah and then addressed Yahya to take the Book firmly.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r1.anchor: أبو إسحاق: (المعنى فوهبنا له وقلنا: {يا يحيى خذ الكتاب بقوة})

WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r2.claim: The Book is the Torah, and taking it firmly means with strength God granted for memorizing and acting on it.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r3.speaker: مجاهد
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r3.claim: He glosses taking it firmly as doing so earnestly.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r3.anchor: مجاهد: (بجد) (¬6). وقال ابن عباس: (بقوة منك أعطيتكها

WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r4.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r4.claim: One explanation of الحكم is prophethood, granted in childhood when Yahya was three.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r4.anchor: يريد النبوة في صباه وهو ابن ثلاث سنين

WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r5.speaker: مجاهد
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r5.claim: Another explanation is understanding: Yahya was given deep comprehension of God's Book and great benefit from it.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r5.anchor: الحكم والفهم هو أنه أعطي فهما لكتاب الله

WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r6.speaker: معمر
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r6.claim: When other children invited him to play, Yahya replied that he had not been created for play.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r6.anchor: معمر: (هو أن الصبيان قالوا له: اذهب بنا نلعب. فقال ما للعب

WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r8.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r8.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r8.claim: In Arabic, الحكم is what prevents ignorance and error and turns a person away from them.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p206/r8.anchor: الحكم عند العرب: ما يمنع من الجهل والخطأ ويصرف عنهما

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:19:11-16/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:19:11-16/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:19:11-16/r2.claim: The Book is the Torah; taking it strongly means God gave it to Yahya and enabled him to memorize and act on it. He received judgment as a child, meaning prophethood in youth.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:19:11-16/r2.anchor: يا يحيى خذ الكتاب } التوراة { بقوة } أعطيتكها وقويتك على حفظها والعمل بما فيها { وآتيناه الحكم صبيا } النبوة في صباه.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p216/r6.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p216/r6.speaker: مجاهد
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p216/r6.claim: Mujāhid and others say taking the Book with strength means doing so earnestly.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p216/r6.anchor: قوله: {يا يحيى خذ الكتاب بقوة} [مريم: 12] قال مجاهد وغيره: بجد.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p216/r7.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p216/r7.speaker: السدي
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p216/r7.claim: Al-Suddī glosses strength as earnestness and perseverance.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p216/r8.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p216/r8.speaker: السدي
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p216/r8.claim: The judgment given to Yahya as a child means understanding and reason.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p216/r8.anchor: {وآتيناه الحكم صبيا} [مريم: 12] يعني: الفهم والعقل وهو تفسير السدي.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p216/r9.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p216/r9.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p216/r9.claim: A report says that when children invited Yahya to play, he replied that they had not been created for play.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p216/r9.anchor: وبلغنا أنه كان في صغره يقول له الصبيان: يا يحيى تعال نلعب، فيقول: ليس للعب خلقنا.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:19:7/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:19:7/r3.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:19:7/r3.claim: No earlier prophet combined Yahya's traits: birth to elderly parents, his unprecedented name, and wisdom in childhood, understood as prophethood or grasp of scripture.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:19:7/r3.anchor: onun ihtiyar bir baba ile kısır ve yaşlı bir anneden dünyaya gelmesi, Yahyâ adının ondan önce hiç kimseye verilmemiş olması

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:19:12/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:19:12/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:19:12/r1.claim: Yahya received no separate book; he was told to understand and follow the Torah revealed to Moses.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:19:12/r1.anchor: Yahyâ’ya herhangi bir kitap indirilmemiş, ancak Hz. Mûsâ’ya indirilmiş olan Tevrat’ı iyi anlayıp onunla amel etmesi emredilmiştir

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:19:12/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:19:12/r2.speaker: Şevkânî
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:19:12/r2.claim: Shawkani explains childhood wisdom as grasping the commanded book and religious rulings, while also listing knowledge, acting on knowledge, prophethood, and intellect as possible senses.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:19:12/r2.anchor: Şevkânî, Yahyâ’ya daha çocukken verilen hikmeti, “kendisine sımsıkı sarılması emredilen kitabı kavrama, dinî hükümleri anlama yeteneği” şeklinde açıklamış

SAMIN-DURR:19:12/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:19:12/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:19:12/r1.claim: Bi-quwwatin is a circumstantial phrase describing either the subject (‘you, equipped with strength’) or the object (‘it, equipped with strength’).
SAMIN-DURR:19:12/r1.anchor: قوله: { بقوة }: حال من الفاعل أو المفعول، أي: ملتبسا أنت، أو ملتبسا هو بقوة

SAMIN-DURR:19:12/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:19:12/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:19:12/r2.claim: Ṣabiyyan is circumstantial of the pronoun in ātaynāhu.
SAMIN-DURR:19:12/r2.anchor: و " صبيا " حال من هاء " آتيناه ".

ZAJJAJ:v3p321/r7.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v3p321/r7.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v3p321/r7.claim: Taking the Book with strength means doing so earnestly, with aid from God.
ZAJJAJ:v3p321/r7.anchor:
أي
بجد وعون من الله - جل وعز

ASAD-NOTES:19:12#n10/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:19:12#n10/r1.speaker: Razi
ASAD-NOTES:19:12#n10/r1.claim: The sequence implies John had grown old enough to receive and understand God's command.
ASAD-NOTES:19:12#n10/r1.anchor: the sequence presupposes that John had in the meantime reached an age which enabled him to receive and understand God's commandment

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.claim: The prophets in Adam’s, Noah’s, and Abraham’s lines preached monotheism, prayer, and zakāh, but their followers turned to polytheism, abandoned the rites, and followed innovations and desires.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.anchor: all celebrated prophets born in the progeny of Adam (sws), Noah (sws) and Abraham (sws) preached monotheism.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.claim: The Prophet is urged to persevere against their hostility and is given glad tidings of success.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.anchor: the Prophet (sws) is urged to show perseverance on their attitude and given glad tidings of success.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.claim: The adversaries mistake worldly success for proof of their truth; it is only respite until the truth is conclusively conveyed and they have no excuse when seized.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.anchor: they regard their worldly successes in contrast to the believers to be a reason of their own veracity.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.claim: Jesus and Mary are prominent because Christians and Jews secretly supported Quraysh; the Qur’an exposes the People of the Book to show they cannot support a truthless cause.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.anchor: the Christians too had begun to secretly support the Quraysh.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.claim: The Zacharias story introduces Mary’s story and counters Christians who treat Jesus’s miraculous birth as proof of his divinity.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.anchor: This incident forms a prelude to the anecdote of Mary (sws) mentioned subsequently.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.claim: The Book John was told to hold fast to is the Torah; Zachariah received no separate revealed Book.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.anchor: obviously refers to the Torah. No separate Book was revealed to Zacharias (sws).

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.claim: Hukm is the ability to distinguish right from wrong; although it generally appears after maturity and peaks around forty, John received it in childhood.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.anchor: It refers to the power and ability to decide between right and wrong.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.claim: The narrative compresses John's birth and growth to maturity before his prophethood; holding fast to God's Book meant guarding against Satan, his eternal enemy, and John ultimately sacrificed his life for it.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-sur.anchor: He was blessed with prophethood from God and was directed by Him to hold fast to the Book of God.

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p4#6/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p4#6/r1.speaker: author
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p4#6/r1.claim: When children invited Yahya to play, he said he was not created for play; God then gave him judgment as a boy.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p4#6/r1.anchor: سمعت معمرا يقول قال الصبيان ليحيى اذهب بنا نلعب فقال ما للعب خلقت

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p237/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p237/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p237/r1.claim: The surah is Meccan like the previous one; Muqatil exempts the prostration verse, saying it was revealed in Medina after the migration to Abyssinia.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p237/r1.anchor: هذه السورة مكية كالسورة التي قبلها. وقال مقاتل: إلا آية

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p237/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p237/r2.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p237/r2.claim: The surahs connect through astonishing stories: the earlier tells of the Cave, Moses and Khidr, and Dhul-Qarnayn; this one of John’s birth to an old man and barren woman and Jesus’ birth without a father.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p237/r2.anchor: ومناسبتها لما قبلها أنه تعالى ضمن السورة قبلها قصصا عجبا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r1.claim: The narrative omits that Yahya was born and grew up; the command came when he was old enough to receive it, through an angel.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r1.anchor: في الكلام حذف والتقدير فلما ولد يحيى وكبر وبلغ السن الذي يؤمر فيه قال الله له على لسان الملك

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r2.speaker: التبريزي
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r2.claim: Al-Tabrīzī implausibly says Yahya's father called him to take the book once he had grown.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r2.anchor: وأبعد التبريزي في قوله إن المنادي له أبوه حين ترعرع ونشأ

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r3.claim: Abū Ḥayyān prefers that God spoke through an angel, citing that Yahya received wisdom as a child.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r3.anchor: والصحيح ما سبق لقوله وآتيناه الحكم صبيا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r4.speaker: ابن عطية
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r4.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya says the book is the Torah, because Yahya was born before Jesus and the Gospel did not yet exist.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r4.anchor: والكتاب هو التوراة. قال ابن عطية بلا خلاف لأنه ولد قبل عيسى ولم يكن الإنجيل موجودا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r5.claim: The author rejects Ibn ʿAṭiyya's claim of consensus: Yahya may have received a distinct book, or the word may mean God's scriptures generally, or Abraham's scrolls.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r5.anchor: وليس كما قال بل قيل له كتاب خص به كما خص كثير من الأنبياء

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r6.speaker: الحسن
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r6.claim: Al-Ḥasan says Yahya was taught the Torah and Gospel, sent to Israel, and prayed, fasted, and called people to God vigorously as a child.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r6.anchor: وقال الحسن وعلمه التوراة والإنجيل وأرسله إلى بني إسرائيل

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r7.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r7.claim: The book's command to be taken 'with strength' means diligent commitment, serious effort, and acting upon it.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r7.anchor: ويدعو إلى الله بقوة بجد واستظهار وعمل بما فيه

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r8.speaker: قيل
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r8.claim: The word ḥukm has been explained as prophethood, judgment from scripture, wisdom, legal knowledge, intellect, devotional manners, or true insight.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r8.anchor: والحكم النبوة أو حكم الكتاب أو الحكمة أو العلم بالأحكام أو اللب وهو العقل

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r9.speaker: قيل
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r9.claim: Ṣabiyyan means a young man before middle age; other reports put Yahya at two or three years old.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r9.anchor: أقوال صبيا أي شابا لم يبلغ سن الكهولة. وقيل: ابن سنتين. وقيل: ابن ثلاث.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r10.speaker: ابن عباس عن النبي
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r10.claim: A report traced to the Prophet says Yahya received this at age seven.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p245/r10.anchor: وعن ابن عباس في حديث مرفوع: «ابن سبع سنين»

BURHAN:v1p481/r5.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p481/r5.speaker: النووي
BURHAN:v1p481/r5.claim: Al-Nawawi allows a ritually impure person to say Qur'anic phrases such as take the Scripture firmly or the travel supplication when intending something other than recitation.
BURHAN:v1p481/r5.anchor: قال النووي رحمه الله إذا قال

DAMGHANI:v1p141/r4.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p141/r4.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p141/r4.claim: Ḥukm can mean understanding and knowledge, as granted to John while still a child.
DAMGHANI:v1p141/r4.anchor: الحكم يعني الفهم والعلم قوله تعالى في سورة مريم

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p489/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p489/r7.speaker: أهل التفسير
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p489/r7.claim: A second Qur'anic sense is diligence and steadfast application.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p489/r7.anchor: وذكر أهل التفسير أن القوة في القرآن على خمسة أوجه
